## What's Changed

### New Features

- Added per-web-host TLS protocol and TLS 1.2 cipher-suite controls.
- Added configurable Gzip and Zstandard response compression.
- Added detailed TLS, cipher, security-header, and compression documentation.

### Optimizations

- Kept map markers readable and compact at every dashboard zoom level.
- Added automatic Gzip fallback when clients do not support Zstandard.

### Bug Fixes

- Prevented managed TLS and compression directives from leaking into additional settings.
- Excluded local agent and security instruction files from the repository.
